# Refrigerator construction-fit repair

The rejected model had shelves narrower than their liner, unsupported drawer walls, door bins without mounting cradles, excessive extraction travel, and independently tilted door fits that could not share a manufactured gasket landing. Original asset MJCF already parented its fixed bins to the doors; its missing door-bin sliding joints and lack of modeled mounts made the viewer's detached appearance worse. The original snapshot is in `evidence/fit_before/`.

The rebuilt appliance has a common square cabinet/door frame, vertical right-edge hinges, continuous shelf bearings, paired crisper guides, a half-width deli drawer below the upper shelf, and five door-mounted sliding bins. Each bin has its own cradle, guide shoulders and mounting blocks, all attached to the appropriate door. The three fresh-food bins and two freezer bins translate along the door's local inward normal when pulled into the room with the door open. Their existing mechanisms-job `*_lift` names are retained as legacy identifiers; the motion is now horizontal as requested. All eleven original asset joint names remain unchanged. The metadata records source-to-asset aliases for the mechanisms job's additional prefixes.

## Measured and manufactured dimensions

Source measurements: `gs_sim/world.json`, `gs_sim/articulation.json`, and undistorted frames f5126, f5360, f5411, f5580 and f6963. The source door rectangles give main width 836.388 mm / height 1262.501 mm and freezer width 797.460 mm / height 567.801 mm, with about 4% source depth-scale uncertainty. Both manufactured doors use 832 mm width and a common upright frame, with main/freezer heights 1239 / 566 mm. The differing observed widths and lean are retained as measurement uncertainty rather than independent deformed doors. Cabinet height is 1855 mm. Manufacturing yaw is -0.080 rad relative to the asset's nominal axis; all parts share it.

Depth-plane measurements and their polygons are saved in `evidence/fit_depth_measurements.json`. Transparent drawer faces and food give inconsistent plane normals; for example, the f5360 deli width is 340.2 mm but its fitted normal has an implausible vertical component. Consequently the shared shelf/drawer dimensions use fixed-camera edge fitting, not a blind plane-normal transplant. `evidence/fit_photo_annotations.json` preserves independent native-pixel traces and fitted parameters. The liner is 712 mm wide; shelf assemblies span 708.17 mm. Glass remains 5 mm thick within its molded frame. Shelf levels are 947.5, 687 and 295 mm. The crisper cover was lowered 85 mm from the rejected build. Deli front width is 341.65 mm; each crisper front is 346.43 mm.

The cabinet gasket landing is at manufacturing y=-322 mm. The storage-bay front (liner shelf-rib noses and drawer-cover fronts) is at y=-150 mm. This deliberate 172 mm recessed throat accommodates the photographed door storage; it is not an unsupported gap between adjacent compartments. Drawer fronts align with this storage-bay front. Open shelf storage space is retained as in the photos; drawer-to-cover gaps are only 2 mm.

## Fit validation

`fit_checks.py` loads the regenerated MuJoCo asset and tests actual exported OBJ bounds, collision hulls and kinematic transforms. It also independently checks the GLB hierarchy. Every check in `fit_report.json` passes: 158 checks, 21 sweeps / 317 sampled poses, plus closed and simultaneous all-joints-maximum poses. Doors are tested every 15 degrees from 0 through 120 degrees with the other door both closed and open; drawers and other joints use 17 samples over their full limits. Parent-child contact filtering is disabled. The collision penetration threshold is 0.02 mm; no sampled pose exceeds it. These are sampled checks, not a continuous-time collision guarantee.

Actual clearances in the closed manufacturing pose:

| Item | Clearance / offset |
| --- | ---: |
| Shelf to liner, each side | 1.914 mm |
| Shelf underside to reinforced liner ledge | approximately 0 mm, seated |
| Deli to its guide compartment, each side | 2.871 mm |
| Crisper to compartment, each side | 2.871 mm |
| Drawer front to shelf/cover front | below 0.001 mm |
| Deli and crisper upper edge to cover | 2.000 mm |
| Every door bin floor to cradle | 0.500 mm |
| Door-bin rear molding to inner panel | 1.000 mm |
| Door-bin front rim to cradle front | below 0.001 mm |
| Main and freezer gasket faces to cabinet | 1.000 mm |
| Each hinge to door side edge | below 0.001 mm |
| Each hinge to cabinet side edge | 4.500 mm |

Shelves travel 280 mm; deli and crispers travel 285 mm; door bins travel 60 mm. Remaining depth overlap is at least 64 mm for every storage slider, exceeding the required 40 mm. The deli stays a child of the upper shelf, crispers stay cabinet children, and all door bins/drawers and the dairy cover remain descendants of the correct door. Interior extraction is checked with doors at 120 degrees. Closing doors onto extended storage is an obstructed operation in a real refrigerator and is not declared collision-free.

The scene sweep uses 111 nearby contact pieces from the real scene's `cabinetry_shell/prep_run` and `room_shell`, including the adjacent counter and right wall. Read-only copies, source hashes and the refrigerator placement are in `evidence/fit_scene_collision/`. No other asset set was modified. The test refreshes these copies if the source XML or refrigerator placement changes.

## Preserved mechanisms

The supplied asset `model.xml` did not contain the stated latch. The authoritative version was located at `gpt6/mechanisms/fridge/mjcf/refrigerator.xml` and copied into `evidence/mechanisms_source/`. Its exact loaded body masses are preserved, including the 12 g light plunger: total 103.87565874 kg. Original friction, damping, armature, spring values, magnetic gains (39 N main / 37 N freezer), and closing cam torques (2.0 / 1.8 Nm) are retained. Pads and strikers were relocated to the repaired gasket landing. Diagnostic position servos were removed so they cannot mask passive mechanism behavior. Inertias are recomputed for the repaired part geometry; masses remain source priors, not newly measured weights.

MuJoCo's `rest` keyframe enables both magnetic actuators and depresses the light plunger by 6 mm. Load it with `mj_resetDataKeyframe(model, data, 0)`. At closed contact the total main/freezer closing torques are 33.590 / 31.770 Nm; the magnetic contribution becomes zero after separation. The 1 mm visual gasket gap has local contact pads that touch the strike surface. Gasket rubber remains a rigid proxy; elastic seal deformation is not simulated. MJCF is authoritative for adhesion and cam behavior; URDF does not have native MuJoCo adhesion semantics.

## Calibrated review

`review/fit_fridge_closed.png`, `fit_fridge_closed_view2.png`, `fit_fridge_open.png` and `fit_fridge_open_view2.png` show both poses from two viewpoints. `fit_fridge_full_travel.png` shows all joints at their maximum. Rendering uses Blender Cycles CPU with four pinned cores. All heavy commands run at nice 19 on cores 16-19; CUDA is not used.

Three opened-fridge source/render overlays are in `review/fit_f5126_overlay.png`, `fit_f5360_overlay.png` and `fit_f6963_overlay.png`; matching standalone renders are beside them. Cyan outlines are projected exported geometry, green traces are independent photo annotations, and amber segments show residuals. Original intrinsics and camera matrices match `ktools.Scene` exactly. The f6963 main-door state is fitted to 83.992 degrees rather than reusing a different frame's 91.920-degree state. This is a pose estimate, not an encoder measurement. Food, hands, lighting and source occlusion remain outside this empty-appliance construction repair.

| Calibrated frame | RMS transverse offset | Maximum transverse offset |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| f5126 | 15.81 mm | 31.89 mm |
| f5360 | 19.99 mm | 40.66 mm |
| f6963 | 8.10 mm | 15.30 mm |

These millimetre offsets are image-plane equivalents at the calibrated rendered edge depth, not independent full 3D measurements. Photo acceptance is 35 mm RMS / 60 mm maximum given the reported ~4% reconstruction scale uncertainty and seven-pixel edge annotation uncertainty. The much tighter 0-5 mm construction tolerances apply to the manufactured simulation geometry. Hidden brackets, drawer extraction stops, material compliance and exact mass distribution remain inferred. The source does not demonstrate horizontal door-bin extraction; that motion is implemented because this repair explicitly requested it.

## Rebuild

From this asset-set directory:

```bash
FRIDGE_SKIP_RENDER=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 nice -n 19 taskset -c 16-19 ~/blender/blender -b -t 4 -P refrigerator/build.py
OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 nice -n 19 taskset -c 16-19 [source workspace] refrigerator/fit_checks.py
OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 nice -n 19 taskset -c 16-19 ~/blender/blender -b -t 4 -P refrigerator/fit_render.py
OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 nice -n 19 taskset -c 16-19 [source workspace] refrigerator/fit_overlays.py
OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 nice -n 19 taskset -c 16-19 [source workspace] refrigerator/fit_checks.py
[source workspace] refrigerator/write_fit_notes.py
```

`build.py` regenerates the visual/contact meshes, GLB, Blend, metadata, URDF and MJCF. `fit_geometry.py` holds the photo-constrained shared construction correction; `fit_mechanisms.py` transplants the source mechanism without changing its masses or force law. Earlier QA images, scores and scripts are historical and are not this repair's acceptance evidence. Nothing was published, no git commands were run, and other asset sets remain untouched.

FIT_DONE

## Connection audit revision

The source model and simulation-rest instance metadata are part of the [connection audit](../../../connection_audit/notes.md). This is not a blanket physics or photo-fit pass. Native contact measurements, failed release trials, source-photo coverage and accepted/rejected pose proposals are recorded there.

Contact geometry uses the authored MJCF convex pieces; open vessels retain separate floors and wall pieces in the revised assembly. Triangle meshes describe the visible surfaces. Source mass, explicit inertia and friction values are priors, not physical measurements. Any retained web3 hold is a display/release policy, not evidence that the asset is supported. Capture poses are retained separately from corrected simulation-rest poses.

Nine inferred door-backed ABS stop ribs are 18 × 158 × 16 mm, with nominal 2 mm closed clearances. Their hidden depth is not photo-verified. Explicit source door mass/inertia are retained; the nominal 15 g geom values do not override explicit inertials. Native 20 N tests establish obstruction in the modeled fixture, not manufacturer authenticity.
